title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Join E.ON’s I&C Pillar, a dynamic £5 billion business serving 60,000 customers and managing 300,000 meter points, with a bold ambition to become the UK’s leading B2B energy supplier. Within our Digital Technology & Change organisation, you’ll be part of an integrated team delivering cutting-edge Change & IT services to power this growth.

The Digital Technology & Change organisation brings together Change Management, Digital Data and Technology, and Partner & Service Management to deliver Change and IT services to the E.ON I&C business. The Senior Software Engineer is a key member of the nBS Digital Solutions team, responsible for leading the development, optimisation and support of effective digital solutions, software and applications. The role provides expert consultancy across the full solution lifecycle, including design, specification, development, testing, deployment, migration and warranty support for nBS-owned and managed digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development of new digital solutions that meet business requirements within the nBS product backlog, driving the delivery of project benefits and acting as a leading practitioner in application development for nBS.
  • Deliver high-quality support and maintenance of existing solutions, ensuring optimal performance, application stability and timely resolution of defects or changes within agreed SLAs.
  • Support the end-to-end delivery of change projects, applying technical knowledge and expertise throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Work collaboratively with third-party developers and E.ON Digital Technologies to optimise solution development and delivery for nBS.
  • Manage and maintain technical environments, including hosting, integrations, access and security considerations.
  • Take ownership of continuous learning and professional development, keeping up to date with solution development platforms, practices and techniques.
  • Champion innovation and continuously challenge traditional thinking to identify new and improved ways of working.
  • Drive insight and added value through the interpretation of customer and user behaviour, using detailed application usage analytics.
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external colleagues and management, clearly and concisely explaining complex technical and system-related issues.
  • Provide trusted technical expertise and specialist knowledge of the nBS Digital Solutions portfolio to assess the impact of proposed changes and identify technological opportunities.
  • Ensure all developments, enhancements and support fixes comply with the DD&C governance model.
  • Mentor and support the developer team by sharing technical expertise, providing guidance and proactively escalating issues and blockers in a professional and effective manner.
What we need from you
  • Proven experience in building successful, sustainable and low-maintenance enterprise-level applications and digital solutions.
  • In-depth specialist knowledge of Intelligent Analytics, DynamiCCs, DynamiCCs Collections, nBS Heritage Salesforce and the wider nBS Digital Solutions ecosystem.
  • Strong experience in software and application development, with an excellent understanding of software design and programming principles.
  • Forward-thinking approach, with the ability to anticipate future requirements and develop scalable solutions.
  • Ability to work across multiple projects, adapting to changing priorities within an agile environment.
  • Understanding of change governance, control processes and project delivery methodologies, including Waterfall and Agile.
  • Strong data-handling skills, with the ability to manipulate, interpret and analyse complex datasets.
  • Experience developing and managing enterprise-level applications, preferably Microsoft .NET based.
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, XML, SQL, Apex, SOAP, C#, VB.NET and Visual Studio.
  • Ability to maintain high standards of development, administration and attention to detail.
  • Strong prioritisation, planning and organisational skills, with the ability to work independently
  • Ability to build effective stakeholder relationships, bridging the gap between technical teams and the wider business with excellent communication skills.
  • Experience analysing processes, identifying opportunities for improvement and coaching colleagues throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively, demonstrating ownership and adaptability when delivering digital change.
  • A curious and innovative mindset, continually seeking better solutions and ways of working.

Please note the closing date may end early if we receive a high volume of applications, please apply at your earliest opportunity.

Here’s what you need to know
  • Award-Winning Workplace - We’re proud to be named a Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2026 and the Best Place to Work for 16–34-year-olds.
  • Outstanding Benefits - Enjoy 26 days of annual leave plus bank holidays, a generous pension, life cover, bonus opportunities, and access to 20 flexible benefits with tax/NI savings.
  • Flexible & Family-Friendly - Our industry-leading hybrid and family-friendly policies earned us double recognition at the Personnel Today Awards 2024. We’re open to discussing how flexibility can work for you.
  • Inclusive & Diverse - We’re the only energy company in the Inclusive Top 50 UK Employers. We’re also proud winners of Best Employer for Women and Human Company of the Year—recognising our inclusive, people-first culture.
  • Support at Every Stage of Life - We’re Fertility Friendly and Menopause Friendly accredited, with inclusive support for everyone.
  • Accessible & Supportive - Do you consider yourself as having a disability? As a Disability Confident Employer, we ensure that disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria move forward to the next stage of our recruitment process, and will make any adjustments needed during the process.
  • Invested in Your Growth - From inclusive talent networks to top-tier development programmes, we’ll support your growth every step of the way.
